newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton posts Austin Chalk well results.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton posts Austin Chalk well results.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Tuesday its Big Creek O.L. #I-H well in the Austin Chalk region produced at an average rate of 19.2 million cubic feet of natural gas per day through a 30/64-inch choke at a flowing tubing pressure of 4,400 pounds.
Hugoton owns a 25 percent working interest in the well and offsetting leases. Production began September 18.
Privately held Reata Oil & Gas Corp is the operator and with its investors owns the remaining working interest.

In other Austin Chalk activity, Hugoton is drilling at 14,938 feet to a projected pilot hole depth of 15,150 feet on the O'Malley #1 site. This well is in Washington County, Texas, in an area where Hugoton owns a 50 percent working interest in over 14,000 undeveloped acres.
